description.value: An ice cream and milkshake shop on Penticton's Lakeshore Drive, operating under the brand 'Cherry On Top Shake Shop' and known for elaborate Belgian chocolate-dipped cones and over-the-top 'Crazy Shakes.' The menu spans creative dipped cone builds, a full milkshake bar with fruity and indulgent flavours, and dairy-free Dole Whip in cherry, pineapple, and swirl. A lively, Instagrammable pit stop right beside the Okanagan lakefront, perfect for a mid-ride treat.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (12 spaces) at 17m; rack at 22m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is reachable and operates under the name 'Cherry On Top Shake Shop' (also called 'Cherry's' in the content), not 'The Peach' as in OSM — a significant name mismatch. The website address (1028 Lakeshore Drive) also differs from the OSM address (185 Lakeshore Drive West), flagged accordingly. The phone number matches (250-486-0388). The site explicitly confirms vegan Dole Whip is available, and the business is seasonal — closed for winter 2025 but operated that season.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'The Peach' but the website title and all content use 'Cherry On Top Shake Shop' / 'Cherry's'. The domain thepeachicecream.com may be a legacy URL.
Address mismatch: OSM lists '185 Lakeshore Drive West' but the website states '1028 Lakeshore Drive, Penticton BC'. One or both records may be outdated or the business may have relocated.
Business is seasonal; website states 'WE ARE CLOSED — We're now closed for the season' (posted 2025-09-02). Open only during summer season.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating seasonal business confirmed active through summer 2025 with a working website; a useful lakefront stop for touring cyclists despite name and address discrepancies that should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.notes: The OSM slug/URL (thepeachicecream.com) and the name 'The Peach' appear to be legacy identifiers; the current trading name is 'Cherry On Top Shake Shop.' Directory editors should verify the correct current address on the ground.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly describes Dole Whip as 'a refreshing vegan sweet treat,' available in cherry, pineapple, and swirl

Takeout.detail: Ice cream cones and milkshakes are served to-go by nature; website describes build-your-own cones and milkshake bar with no indication of dine-in seating

Packed lunches.detail: Menu is exclusively ice cream, dipped cones, and milkshakes — no savoury or lunch items listed

wow_evidence: lively, Instagrammable pit stop right beside the Okanagan lakefront
